svg.title: What a supervisor-harness run writes where
svg.desc: Every event is appended to runs/<id>/events.jsonl under a lock and fsynced; RunState is folded from it, and state.json and index.sqlite3 are derived from RunState and rebuildable.

text.tspan: The event log is the only thing that is not derived. Everything else can be rebuilt from it, and is.
a turn, a directive, a decision, a verdict
one advisory lock, one fsync, one batch per turn
append-only, ordered by seq, never rewritten
credential-shaped strings redacted on the way in
replay in seq order, one event at a time
agents, tasks, findings, turns, facts, directives,
read only when last_seq reaches the log's
own tail; otherwise refolded from it
one row per run, agent, task, criterion,
A crash costs what had not been emitted yet,
A snapshot from a process that died mid-run is
behind, not wrong: the next read refolds. Losing
the index costs the answers until supervisor
reindex is run, not the run itself.
in memory, folded from the log
Details: docs/architecture.md, What is written where
